items.prompt: Two workers each accept a candidate from the same old available-cash snapshot. What is missing?

options.why: Each candidate alone can be valid while their union breaches limits.

options.text: Publishing both individually valid candidates without checking their common base revision
options.why: Their combined reservations may exceed the shared cash or position limit even if each candidate passes alone.

options.text: An unbounded timestamp retry with no check
options.why: Reload and recheck under a defined concurrency protocol.

options.text: Automatic release of all unknown orders

items.explanation: Serialize or use a transaction/revision conflict protocol around the shared state transition.
